title: How to Design a Hellion and More!

entities.name: Thelon of Havenwood
entities.description: An elf who bred and nurtured Thallids as a food source long ago.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: A fungal race bred as food by Thelon, reproducing by budding off Saprolings.

entities.name: Saprolings
entities.description: Sporelike organisms budded off by Thallids.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: A servant race bred by the Order of the Ebon Hand as sacrifices, which eventually overwhelmed their masters.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: The order that bred Thrulls as sacrifices.

entities.name: Endrek Sahr
entities.description: A master breeder whose experimentation produced versatile Thrull variations.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Artifact creatures native to Mirrodin, the eyes and ears of Memnarch.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane native to the Myr.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: Savage-minded reptilian humanoids descended from Dragons.

events.summary: Thelon of Havenwood bred Thallids as a food source, and they became a race unto themselves.
events.quote: Bred and nurtured as a food source by the Elf Thelon of Havenwood long, long ago, Thallids have become a race unto themselves.

events.summary: Thrulls bred by the Order of the Ebon Hand as sacrifices eventually overwhelm their masters.
events.quote: Thrull subspecies selected for intelligence and combat eventually overwhelmed their masters.

relations.note: The Myr are Memnarch's eyes and ears.
relations.quote: the eyes and ears of its planar regent, Memnarch
